title: No More Fear Here
summary: Saegel Bascombe's solo exhibition at the Art Society, with an opening-night artist talk and steel-orchestra performance.
description: Saegel Bascombe's solo exhibition opens Tuesday 29 September from 5:00 pm to 8:30 pm at the Art Society of Trinidad and Tobago in Federation Park. The official Art Society page lists an artist talk at 5:30 pm and ProviQRC Steel Orchestra at 6:30 pm. The exhibition continues Wednesday 30 September through Saturday 3 October, with gallery hours Wed–Fri 12:00–6:00 pm and Sat 12:00–4:00 pm. The official page does not state an admission price, so this proposal does not claim that it is free.
